new_persons.name: Lydia Clark (Wife of Whittington)
new_persons.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Widow of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; received the widow's share ($14.50) in the distribution of his estate, 22 Aug 1837 (Delaware Public Archives 4545-000-009). Not the Lydia Clark born 1834 who married Bowen Harmon.

new_persons.name: Nathaniel Clark (Son of Whittington)
new_persons.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Son and heir of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; bought at the estate sale 1836 and received an heir's share ($5.80) 22 Aug 1837. Not the Nathaniel Clark born 1880.

new_persons.name: Latin Clark
new_persons.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Son and heir of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; his share ($5.80) in the 22 Aug 1837 distribution was receipted by the widow Lydia Clark, consistent with a minor. Name as written in the account.
